full_judgment: 23. Mr. Rahim lastly submits that Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 as special law provided specific provision in section 19 to challenge an ex-parte decree within 15 days from the date of knowledge subject payment of 10% decretal dues but the writ petitioner although waited for long 4 months from his knowledge but tried to bypass mandatory precondition of deposit and as such his application under section 57 of the Ain is not only barred by limitation but also barred by section 19 of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003.
